title: WS 4900 Custom Build FUPS Road Train Bullbar #3
description: Western Star 4900 Custom Built polished hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Road Train bullbar. High tensile 88mm heavy duty walled diameter pipe. One piece pipes on main cross pipes pass through drilled heavy duty narrow depth uprights, no butt welds. The narrow uprights reduce the forward projection measurement and suit tight maximum overall length restrictions. Rversable flip ober aluminium Over Size/Road Train signs. An additional centre pipe gives afdditional protection to the radiator area. Indicator repeaters/ Daylight running lights in outer uprights. The main channel is contoured to match the front wheel profile. The main bar is fitted with 6mm high tensile support gussets. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Heavy duty mesh protection for headlights. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements.
